### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Notice-period adjustment credit on 869c115b…. Baseline (doc_care_final_month_credit_calculation): notice period 14 (program figure) from receipt day 0 -> 2025-12-14; billing end 2025-12-14 falls in December -> credit nothing (fall-back 0.00, i.e. no credit). Factors: counting day (Sunday -> Monday 2025-12-01); notice length by plan (2 days -> 7) -> last day 2025-12-08; billing end max(12-04, 12-08) = 2025-12-08; proration convention: 2025-26 district record status year_completed (not withdrawn), CKC enrollment withdrawn, no suspension date, notice on file -> by whole week: 12-08 -> 2 whole weeks to day 28 -> 50 percent; credit base: CCS-funded, board remittance 80.00 posted for 2025-12 -> 128.00 - 80.00 = 48.00. Credit = 0.50 x 48.00 = **24.00**.
(b) First installment (pay_prior_year_installment, online_card). Open balance before (a): charges 40 + 128 + 48 + 30 + 15 + 128 + 15 = 404.00; reductions 40 + 48 + 93 + 80 + 80 = 341.00; 63.00; after (a) 39.00. Count: size scale 39.00 -> 2; hardship: active meal account Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) (benefit level free), effective 2026-07-01 <= 2026-08-04 -> +2; residence term: 2026-27 district record enrolled, Non-Resident Transfer -> -1; returned-payment term: one return 2025-11-10 within 12 months before 2026-08-04 -> -1. 2 + 2 - 1 - 1 = 2. Installment rule: final billed month 2025-12 carries a late payment fee 15.00 -> 15.00 + (39.00 - 15.00)/2 = **27.00**. Fall-back (computation doc only): 39.00 (one installment) — definite and different. Factor findability: meal account row (School Nutrition Services), district enrollment record (Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions) Non-Resident Transfer, care_returned_payment row, care_late_payment_fee for 2025-12.

### 6. Problem tree
Root: first installment (customer's own write). doc_care_prior_year_balance_installments: "The first installment is not fixed until the enrollment's final billed month has been credited for the part of its tuition that the notice period does not reach." Records: no notice_period_adjustment credit on the ledger; final billed month 2025-12. Words "credited ... the part of its tuition that the notice period does not reach" lead to doc_care_notice_period_adjustment_credit ("credits a withdrawn enrollment for the tuition of its final billed month that care and the notice period do not reach ... posted as a notice-period adjustment"). **state-derived**. - Alternatives: proration by the day excluded (district record not withdrawn); credit base whole charge excluded by the CCS row and the 2025-12 remittance; counting day the Sunday excluded by the counting-day table; district record 2025-26 for the residence term excluded ("The school year read is 2026-27").

- Look-back boundary: the only return (2025-11-10) is far from the boundary (2025-08-04); no doc states whether a return dated exactly 12 months before the payment day counts. Judged in gt_comparison.
